Install Siyanat Marol App

For iPhone & iPad (Safari)

1

Tap the Share Button

At the bottom toolbar of Safari on iPhone (or top right on iPad), tap the Share icon .

2

Tap "Add to Home Screen"

Scroll down in the share sheet menu and tap Add to Home Screen .

3

Confirm & Tap "Add"

Tap Add in the top-right corner. The Siyanat app icon will appear directly on your Home Screen!

Install App on Mac (macOS)

Apple Desktop / MacBook PWA Setup

In Safari (macOS Sonoma 14+):

  1. Click File in the top menu bar (or click the Share icon ).
  2. Select Add to Dock....
  3. Click Add. Siyanat Marol will be installed to your Mac Dock & Launchpad as a standalone app!

In Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge on Mac:

Click the Install icon on the right side of the address bar, or click the ⋮ menu > Save and share > Install Siyanat Marol....

Install Siyanat Marol App

Android & Desktop Chrome / Edge

On Android (Chrome / Samsung Internet):

Tap the browser menu ⋮ (top-right) and select "Install app" or "Add to Home screen".

On Laptop / Desktop (Chrome / Edge):

Click the Install icon on the right side of your browser's address bar to install as a standalone desktop app.

Automated Daily Bill Fetch Setup (Adani Electricity & Mahanagar Gas)

How to automatically pull all 27 Adani & 7 MGL bills, save PDFs to fm.marol Drive, and populate Amount & Units daily.

Synced Across Devices

In Google Apps Script → Deploy → Manage deployments, click Copy under Web app URL (e.g. https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbzmdma.../exec) and paste it here so the portal calls your latest Version 5 deployment:

How Daily Auto-Fetch Works (100% Free via Your Existing fm.marol Google Apps Script)

Because Adani Electricity and Mahanagar Gas protect their public web portals with CAPTCHA/OTP and browser CORS blocks direct webpage scraping, the most reliable automated architecture uses your existing fm.marol Google Apps Script running on a Daily Time-Driven Trigger:

  1. Register E-Bills to fm.marol@jameasaifiyah.edu: Add your department email on Adani Electricity (for all 27 CA numbers) and Mahanagar Gas (for all 7 CA numbers) so official monthly PDF bills arrive in your inbox automatically. (Alternatively, connect a Bharat BillPay / BBPS API key in the script).
  2. Add the Auto-Fetch Function to Your Google Apps Script: Paste the script below into the same Google Apps Script project that powers your GOOGLE_SCRIPT_URL Drive uploader.
  3. Set a Daily Trigger (e.g. Every Day at 8:00 AM): In Google Apps Script, click Triggers (⏰ icon) → + Add Trigger → Function: autoFetchAdaniAndMglBillsDaily → Time-driven → Day timer.

                        Keys Inventory — Firebase Firestore Schema & WATI API Specification
                    

                    
Production schema for `keys`, `issued_keys`, `directory` and WATI WhatsApp template endpoints.

                

                
            

            


// 1. FIREBASE FIRESTORE / RTDB SCHEMA DESIGN
// Collection: "keys" (Master Inventory)
{
  "id": "key_AA_MK_001",
  "keyId": "AA/MK/001",                  // Unique Key ID
  "area": "Academic & Admin Bldg",       // Supported or Custom Area/Building
  "floor": "-",                          // Floor
  "roomNo": "-",                         // Room No.
  "details": "Offices Main Door - 1500", // Key Details / Description
  "storageLocation": "Cupboard 1 - Row 1 - A",
  "totalKeys": 8,                        // Total Keys Available
  "keysInStore": 7,                      // Keys currently in store
  "holders": [                           // Active Key Holders (mirrored in "issued_keys" collection)
    {
      "id": "iss_1731340000",
      "keyId": "AA/MK/001",
      "holderName": "Mulla Murtaza bhai Shaikh Shabbir bhai Kheraluwala",
      "holderIts": "30476900",
      "holderMobile": "918320039709",
      "isDirectoryMatch": true,          // false -> triggers warning sign if not in directory
      "issueDate": "2026-09-01",         // YYYY-MM-DD (rendered as DD-MMM-YYYY)
      "expiryDate": "2026-12-31",        // YYYY-MM-DD (triggers flashing red alert if past expiry)
      "status": "active",                // "active" | "returned"
      "whatsappSent": true,              // Tracks tick mark button state
      "whatsappTemplateUsed": "key_issue_updated",
      "whatsappSentAt": "2026-11-11T10:30:00.000Z"
    }
  ],
  "history": [],                         // Archived returned issuances
  "updatedAt": "2026-11-11"
}

// Collection: "issued_keys" (Normalized Issuance Ledger)
{
  "id": "iss_1731340000",
  "keyDocId": "key_AA_MK_001",
  "keyId": "AA/MK/001",
  "area": "Academic & Admin Bldg",
  "floor": "-",
  "roomNo": "-",
  "details": "Offices Main Door - 1500",
  "holderName": "Mulla Murtaza bhai Shaikh Shabbir bhai Kheraluwala",
  "holderIts": "30476900",
  "holderMobile": "918320039709",
  "isDirectoryMatch": true,
  "issueDate": "2026-09-01",
  "expiryDate": "2026-12-31",
  "returnDate": null,
  "status": "active",
  "whatsappSent": true,
  "whatsappTemplateUsed": "key_issue_updated"
}

// Collection: "directory" (Populates Assignee Dropdown & People Tracker)
{
  "id": "fac_1",
  "its": "30476900",
  "name": "Mulla Murtaza bhai Shaikh Shabbir bhai Kheraluwala",
  "category": "Staff",
  "gender": "Male",
  "contact": "918320039709"
}

//   {{1}}: "[Name]-[ITS]"
//   {{2}}: "[Building/Floor/Room/Details]"
//   {{3}}: "[DD-MMM-YYYY]" (Issue Date)
//   {{4}}: "[DD-MMM-YYYY]" (Expiry Date)
// Template 2: "key_issue_imtehan" -> customParams:

//   {{2}}: "[Building/Floor/Room/Details]"
//   {{3}}: "[DD/MM/YYYY]" (Issue Date)
//   {{4}}: "[DD/MM/YYYY]" (Expiry Date)
// Template 3: "key_return" -> customParams:
//   {{1}}: "[Name]"
//   {{2}}: "[Building/Floor/Room/Details]"
//   {{3}}: "[DD-MMM-YYYY]" (Return Date)
